sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite their strong league position, Sandbach have won only one of their last five matches (L-W-D-W-W), most recently suffering a loss. Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are in dire form, having won only once in their last five outings, making this a favorable fixture for the leaders to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back after consecutive defeats and maintain pressure on Sandbach at the summit. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two strong performers—Eccleshall have won four of their last five matches and sit fifth, while AFC Bridgnorth are also in good form despite recent losses. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in-form, welcome Wednesfield Community, who have won their last two matches despite a patchy overall record. Bilston Town (sixth) face Foley Meir at home, with Bilston unbeaten in their last four games. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, both seeking consistency after mixed recent form. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, the division's basement club on 2 points; Widnes are without a win in seven matches. Shawbury United, struggling at 15th, host Barnton in what both sides will view as a chance to pick up points. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a clash of two of the division's poorest-performing sides. Additionally, Brereton Social play Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45, with both teams chasing improvement in mid-table.
